name: @ikenga/pkg-git-ui
description: com.ikenga.git iframe UI — side-menu shell (Changes · History · Branches · Worktrees · PRs), theme mirroring, no-root empty states, mocked-sidecar dev mode. Bundled by vite into the PKG ROOT's ../dist (not ui/dist) — the shell hardcodes an iframe pkg's content root to <pkg>/dist, so that is where manifest.json's ui.routes source `dist/index.html` resolves.
